"""Reproduce: min-similarity-lines=0 via the linter path (rcfile equivalent)."""
from pylint.lint import PyLinter
from pylint.testutils.reporter_for_tests import GenericTestReporter
from pylint.checkers import similar


def run(minlines):
    linter = PyLinter(reporter=GenericTestReporter())
    linter.register_checker(similar.SimilarChecker(linter))
    linter.config.min_similarity_lines = minlines
    linter.check(["tests/input/similar_cls_a.py", "tests/input/similar_cls_b.py"])
    out = linter.reporter.out.getvalue()
    checker = linter.get_checker(similar.SimilarChecker) if hasattr(linter, "get_checker") else None
    stats = linter.stats
    return out, stats, checker


out4, stats4, ch4 = run(4)
out0, stats0, _ = run(0)
print("default(4): R0801 occurrences in output:", out4.count("R0801"))
print("  nb_duplicated_lines:", stats4.get("nb_duplicated_lines"))
print("min=0:     R0801 occurrences in output:", out0.count("R0801"))
print("  nb_duplicated_lines:", stats0.get("nb_duplicated_lines"))
print("--- default(4) output head ---")
